label: preparing
what: A coordinated residents' gathering in the great hall at eighteen sharp, with refreshments and a private community presentation whose details have been withheld from me. It may celebrate my forty years of service, but that is unconfirmed. The innkeeper hosts and escorts me without early arrival; secretary coordinates appointments, builder relays escort plans, and freight reports bread and lanterns supplied and further bread sought. Other participants, including any baker involvement, are not established.
